Your own break on a fresh rack. No turns, no fouls.
Eight-ball
Two players. Claim solids or stripes, clear them, then sink the 8.
Nine-ball
Two players. Always hit the lowest ball first; sink the 9 to win.
Rules
Solids, stripes and the 8.
Lowest ball first, and the 9 wins.
Two players share one table. One takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.

A good break sinks a ball or drives at least four balls to a cushion. If it does neither, your opponent may play the table as it lies or have it racked again. Sink the cue ball on the break and your opponent places it anywhere behind the head line.
The 8 on the break
Sinking the 8 on the break neither wins nor loses. The breaker chooses: put the 8 back on its spot, or rack again.
An open table
After the break nobody owns a group. The first ball you call and sink on a fair shot makes its group yours.
Call every shot
Before each shot, name the ball and the pocket. The game suggests the ball you are aiming at and the nearest pocket, so one tap confirms it.
A fair shot
Hit one of your own balls first, or the 8 once your group is gone. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
Fouls
Sinking the cue ball, hitting the wrong ball first, hitting nothing, or knocking a ball off the table is a foul. Your opponent then has ball in hand: they place the cue ball anywhere.
Keep your turn
Sink the ball you called and you shoot again. Miss it, or foul, and the turn passes.
Winning and losing
Sink the 8 in the pocket you called once your group is gone and you win. Sink it early, in the wrong pocket, off the table, or on a foul, and you lose.
Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
Lowest ball first
Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
No calling
You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
Three fouls
Three fouls in a row by the same player lose the game. The game warns you after the second.

translations.key: A good break sinks a ball or drives at least four balls to a cushion. If it does neither, your opponent may play the table as it lies or have it racked again. Sink the cue ball on the break and your opponent places it anywhere behind the head line.
translations.text: Un buen saque mete una bola o lleva al menos cuatro bolas a una banda. Si no hace ninguna de las dos cosas, tu rival puede jugar la mesa como está o pedir que se vuelvan a colocar. Si metes la blanca en el saque, tu rival la coloca donde quiera detrás de la línea de saque.

translations.key: A good break sinks a ball or drives at least four balls to a cushion. If it does neither, your opponent may play the table as it lies or have it racked again. Sink the cue ball on the break and your opponent places it anywhere behind the head line.
translations.text: Une bonne casse empoche une bille ou envoie au moins quatre billes à une bande. Si elle ne fait ni l'un ni l'autre, votre adversaire peut jouer la table telle quelle ou faire remettre le triangle. Si la blanche tombe à la casse, votre adversaire la place où il veut derrière la ligne de tête.

translations.key: A good break sinks a ball or drives at least four balls to a cushion. If it does neither, your opponent may play the table as it lies or have it racked again. Sink the cue ball on the break and your opponent places it anywhere behind the head line.
translations.text: Ein guter Anstoß versenkt eine Kugel oder treibt mindestens vier Kugeln an eine Bande. Gelingt keins von beiden, darf dein Gegner den Tisch so spielen, wie er liegt, oder neu aufbauen lassen. Versenkst du beim Anstoß die weiße Kugel, legt dein Gegner sie beliebig hinter die Kopflinie.

translations.text: Uma boa abertura mete uma bola ou leva pelo menos quatro bolas a uma tabela. Se não fizer nenhuma das duas coisas, o adversário pode jogar a mesa como está ou mandar arrumar de novo. Se meter a bola branca na abertura, o adversário coloca-a onde quiser atrás da linha de cabeceira.

Se encaçapar a bola branca na abertura, o adversário a coloca onde quiser atrás da linha de cabeceira.

translations.key: A good break sinks a ball or drives at least four balls to a cushion. If it does neither, your opponent may play the table as it lies or have it racked again. Sink the cue ball on the break and your opponent places it anywhere behind the head line.
translations.text: よいブレイクとは、球を1つ沈めるか、少なくとも4個の球をクッションまで運ぶことです。どちらもできなければ、相手はそのままの配置で打つか、並べ直しを求められます。ブレイクで手球を落とすと、相手がヘッドラインの後ろの好きな場所に置きます。

translations.text: 좋은 브레이크는 공 하나를 넣거나 공 네 개 이상을 쿠션까지 보냅니다. 둘 다 못하면 상대는 그대로 치거나 다시 랙을 놓게 할 수 있습니다. 브레이크에서 수구를 넣으면 상대가 헤드 라인 뒤 아무 곳에나 놓습니다.

translations.key: A good break sinks a ball or drives at least four balls to a cushion. If it does neither, your opponent may play the table as it lies or have it racked again. Sink the cue ball on the break and your opponent places it anywhere behind the head line.

translations.text: Восьмёрка, забитая на разбое, не приносит ни победы, ни поражения. Разбивавший выбирает: вернуть восьмёрку на её точку или расставить заново.

translations.key: After the break nobody owns a group. The first ball you call and sink on a fair shot makes its group yours.
translations.text: 开球后谁都没有球组。你在合法击球中第一个报出并打进的球，它所在的球组就归你。

translations.key: After the break nobody owns a group. The first ball you call and sink on a fair shot makes its group yours.
translations.text: После разбоя ни у кого нет группы. Первый шар, который вы заказали и забили честным ударом, делает его группу вашей.

translations.key: Sink the 8 in the pocket you called once your group is gone and you win. Sink it early, in the wrong pocket, off the table, or on a foul, and you lose.
translations.text: 自己的球组打完后，把 8 号球打进所报袋口就赢。提前打进、打进错袋、打出台面或犯规时打进，就输。

translations.key: Sink the 8 in the pocket you called once your group is gone and you win. Sink it early, in the wrong pocket, off the table, or on a foul, and you lose.
translations.text: Забейте восьмёрку в заказанную лузу, когда ваша группа закончилась, — и вы победили. Забили раньше, не в ту лузу, выбили со стола или с фолом — проиграли.

translations.key: Sink the 8 in the pocket you called once your group is gone and you win. Sink it early, in the wrong pocket, off the table, or on a foul, and you lose.
translations.text: أدخل الكرة 8 في الجيب الذي سمّيته بعد أن تنتهي مجموعتك وتفوز. أدخلها مبكرًا، أو في الجيب الخطأ، أو أخرجها من الطاولة، أو مع خطأ، فتخسر.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: Solo se usan las bolas del 1 al 9, colocadas en rombo con la 1 delante y la 9 en el centro. Quien mete la 9 en un tiro válido gana, sea cuando sea.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: Seules les billes 1 à 9 servent, en losange avec la 1 devant et la 9 au milieu. Celui qui empoche la 9 sur un coup valable gagne, à tout moment.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: Nur die Kugeln 1 bis 9 werden gespielt, als Raute aufgebaut, die 1 vorn und die 9 in der Mitte. Wer die 9 mit einem fairen Stoß versenkt, gewinnt, wann immer das passiert.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: Si usano solo le bilie dall'1 al 9, disposte a rombo con l'1 davanti e la 9 al centro. Chi imbuca la 9 con un colpo valido vince, in qualunque momento.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: Só se usam as bolas de 1 a 9, arrumadas em losango com a 1 à frente e a 9 no meio. Quem meter a 9 numa tacada válida ganha, seja quando for.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: Só as bolas de 1 a 9 são usadas, arrumadas em losango com a 1 na frente e a 9 no meio. Quem encaçapar a 9 numa tacada válida vence, a qualquer momento.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: 使うのは1番から9番の球だけで、1番を先頭、9番を中央にしたひし形に並べます。正しいショットで9番を沈めた人の勝ち。いつでも構いません。

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: 1번부터 9번 공만 쓰며, 1번을 앞에, 9번을 가운데에 두고 마름모로 놓습니다. 정당한 샷으로 9번을 넣는 사람이 언제든 승리합니다.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: 只用 1 到 9 号球，摆成菱形，1 号在最前，9 号在中间。谁在合法击球中打进 9 号球谁就赢，无论何时。

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: Используются только шары с 1 по 9, расставленные ромбом: единица впереди, девятка в центре. Кто забьёт девятку честным ударом, тот и победил, когда бы это ни случилось.

translations.key: Only the balls 1 to 9 are used, racked in a diamond with the 1 at the front and the 9 in the middle. Whoever sinks the 9 on a fair shot wins, whenever it happens.
translations.text: تُستخدم الكرات من 1 إلى 9 فقط، مرصوصة على شكل معيّن والكرة 1 في المقدمة والكرة 9 في الوسط. من يُدخل الكرة 9 بضربة صحيحة يفوز، متى حدث ذلك.

Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: Cada tiro debe golpear primero la bola de número más bajo de la mesa. Después, una bola debe entrar o alguna bola debe llegar a una banda.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: Chaque coup doit toucher d'abord la bille au plus petit numéro sur la table. Ensuite, une bille doit tomber ou une bille doit atteindre une bande.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: Jeder Stoß muss zuerst die Kugel mit der niedrigsten Zahl auf dem Tisch treffen. Danach muss eine Kugel fallen oder irgendeine Kugel eine Bande erreichen.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: Ogni colpo deve toccare per prima la bilia col numero più basso sul tavolo. Poi una bilia deve cadere o una qualsiasi deve toccare una sponda.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: Cada tacada tem de acertar primeiro na bola de número mais baixo na mesa. Depois, uma bola tem de cair ou alguma bola tem de chegar a uma tabela.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: Toda tacada tem que acertar primeiro a bola de número mais baixo na mesa. Depois, uma bola tem que cair ou alguma bola tem que chegar a uma tabela.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: どのショットも、台上で一番小さい番号の球に最初に当てなければなりません。その後、球が落ちるか、どれかの球がクッションに届く必要があります。

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: 모든 샷은 테이블에서 가장 낮은 번호의 공을 먼저 맞혀야 합니다. 그다음 공이 들어가거나 어떤 공이든 쿠션에 닿아야 합니다.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: 每一杆都必须先碰台面上号码最小的球。之后必须有球落袋，或有任意球碰到库边。

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: Каждый удар должен сначала попасть в шар с наименьшим номером на столе. Затем шар должен упасть или любой шар должен дойти до борта.

translations.key: Every shot must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Then a ball must drop or any ball must reach a cushion.
translations.text: يجب أن تضرب كل ضربة أولًا الكرة ذات الرقم الأصغر على الطاولة. بعد ذلك يجب أن تسقط كرة أو تصل أي كرة إلى الحافة.

You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: No cantas tus tiros: cuenta cualquier bola que entre en un tiro válido. El juego marca la bola que debes golpear primero.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: Vous n'annoncez pas vos coups : toute bille qui tombe sur un coup valable compte. Le jeu marque la bille à toucher en premier.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: Du sagst deine Stöße nicht an: Jede Kugel, die bei einem fairen Stoß fällt, zählt. Das Spiel markiert die Kugel, die du zuerst treffen musst.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: Non chiami i colpi: conta ogni bilia che cade con un colpo valido. Il gioco segna la bilia da colpire per prima.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: Não anuncia as tacadas: conta qualquer bola que caia numa tacada válida. O jogo marca a bola em que tem de acertar primeiro.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: Você não canta as tacadas: vale qualquer bola que cair numa tacada válida. O jogo marca a bola que você precisa acertar primeiro.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: ショットのコールはしません。正しいショットで落ちた球はすべて有効です。最初に当てるべき球はゲームが示します。

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: 샷을 콜하지 않습니다. 정당한 샷에서 들어간 공은 모두 인정됩니다. 먼저 맞혀야 할 공은 게임이 표시합니다.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: 不用报球：合法击球中落袋的任何球都算。游戏会标出你必须先碰的球。

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: Удары не заказываются: считается любой шар, упавший при честном ударе. Игра отмечает шар, в который нужно попасть первым.

translations.key: You do not name your shots: any ball that drops on a fair shot counts. The game marks the ball you must hit first.
translations.text: لا تسمّي ضرباتك: تُحتسب أي كرة تسقط بضربة صحيحة. تحدد اللعبة الكرة التي يجب أن تضربها أولًا.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: Mete cualquier bola en un tiro válido y vuelves a tirar.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: Empochez n'importe quelle bille sur un coup valable et vous rejouez.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: Versenkst du bei einem fairen Stoß irgendeine Kugel, stößt du noch einmal.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: Imbuca una bilia qualsiasi con un colpo valido e tiri di nuovo.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: Meta qualquer bola numa tacada válida e volta a jogar.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: Encaçape qualquer bola numa tacada válida e jogue de novo.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: 正しいショットでどれかの球を沈めれば、もう一度打てます。

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: 정당한 샷으로 아무 공이나 넣으면 다시 칩니다.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: 合法击球打进任何一颗球，就继续击球。

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: Забили любой шар честным ударом — бьёте снова.

translations.key: Sink any ball on a fair shot and you shoot again.
translations.text: أدخل أي كرة بضربة صحيحة وتضرب مرة أخرى.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: Una falta da a tu rival bola en mano en cualquier lugar de la mesa. Una 9 metida con falta vuelve a su punto.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: Une faute donne à votre adversaire la bille en main n'importe où sur la table. Une 9 empochée sur une faute revient sur sa mouche.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: Ein Foul gibt deinem Gegner Ball in Hand irgendwo auf dem Tisch. Eine mit Foul versenkte 9 kommt zurück auf ihren Punkt.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: Un fallo dà all'avversario la bilia in mano ovunque sul tavolo. Una 9 imbucata con fallo torna sul suo punto.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: Uma falta dá ao adversário bola na mão em qualquer ponto da mesa. Uma 9 metida com falta volta ao seu ponto.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: Uma falta dá ao adversário bola na mão em qualquer lugar da mesa. Uma 9 encaçapada com falta volta para o ponto.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: ファウルをすると、相手は台のどこにでも手球を置けるボールインハンドになります。ファウルで落ちた9番はスポットに戻ります。

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: 파울하면 상대가 테이블 아무 곳에나 볼 인 핸드를 얻습니다. 파울로 들어간 9번은 제자리로 돌아옵니다.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: 犯规后对手获得自由球，可放在台面任意位置。犯规时打进的 9 号球放回置球点。

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: Фол даёт сопернику шар с руки в любое место стола. Девятка, забитая с фолом, возвращается на свою точку.

translations.key: A foul gives your opponent ball in hand anywhere on the table. A 9 sunk on a foul comes back to its spot.
translations.text: الخطأ يمنح خصمك الكرة في اليد في أي مكان على الطاولة. والكرة 9 التي تدخل مع خطأ تعود إلى نقطتها.

translations.text: Drei Fouls in Folge vom selben Spieler verlieren die Partie. Das Spiel warnt dich nach dem zweiten.

translations.text: 同じプレイヤーが3回続けてファウルすると負けです。2回目の後に警告が出ます。

translations.key: Three fouls in a row by the same player lose the game. The game warns you after the second.
translations.text: 같은 플레이어가 파울을 세 번 연속하면 패배합니다. 두 번째 뒤에 경고가 나옵니다.

translations.key: Three fouls in a row by the same player lose the game. The game warns you after the second.
translations.text: 同一名球员连续三次犯规即判负。第二次犯规后游戏会提醒你。

translations.key: Three fouls in a row by the same player lose the game. The game warns you after the second.
translations.text: Три фола подряд одного игрока — поражение. Игра предупредит после второго.

translations.key: Three fouls in a row by the same player lose the game. The game warns you after the second.
translations.text: ثلاثة أخطاء متتالية من اللاعب نفسه تعني خسارة المباراة. تنبّهك اللعبة بعد الخطأ الثاني.
